name: Manovo-Gounda St Floris National Park
description: This vast national park in the north of the Central African Republic, close to the Chad border, protects open savannah and seasonal floodplains. Black rhinoceroses, elephants, cheetahs, leopards, wild dogs and buffalo roam its grasslands, while waterfowl gather on the northern wetlands. Inscribed in 1988, it is now listed as World Heritage in Danger.
